newsitem.title: TURKEY: 36 killed in rebel Kurdish violence in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: 36 killed in rebel Kurdish violence in Turkey.

text.p: Turkish security officials said 30 rebel Kurdish militants and six government-paid village guards were killed in a clash in eastern Turkey on Saturday morning.
They said the clash took place near Catak town in Van province near the Iranian border between the guards and militants of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
Nine guards were wounded in the incident, they said.
More than 24,000 people have been killed in the PKK's 12-year-old struggle for an independent or autonomous state in southeast Turkey.
